changes: Image Editor: a color swatch sits left of the R/G/B sliders, 8-bit RGB sits next to Hex, and the Pal/index/CRAM header line is gone
Image Editor paint copies a unique tile when that 8×8 is shared (including H/V-flipped squares), so painting one cell does not draw into the others
Paint writes the selected color index and leaves the cell’s palette; it does not recolor the whole 8×8
Image Editor Import has a Color mode: Genesis 3-bit (GEN) or SNES 5-bit (SNES)
3-bit (GEN) / 5-bit (SNES) color reduction only: Step A only, palettes off, export PNG
Reduce count only (for export): keeps 8-bit color, palettes off, export PNG
Export asks to apply a floating image first, or cancel and leave Export closed
The centre pane grows so Apply and import previews stay on screen
Floating import: Pal moves clicked or dragged tiles onto the selected palette and rebuilds that pal from all tiles on it; Optimize (next to Pal) groups matching tiles to free ink slots
Lock on a palette does not rebuild a floating import; Lock seams keeps Pal assignments when color options change
Image Editor starts with palettes at 0,0,0; type #RRGGBB (Genesis snaps to 3-bit × 36); pals with no tiles go back to black
5-bit quantization is available everywhere 3-bit is
Image Editor tools have icons, labels, and a mouse cursor that matches the selected tool
Erase cell writes a blank tile filled with palette color 0
Paste and Import into current Image float with a dotted outline until you Apply
Export is a format picker
Remove duplicate tiles, including H-flip and V-flip matches; new-image and import-into-image do this automatically
Import .pal and .snespal palettes and choose which file lines fill which editor pals
Select is the default Image Editor tool; toolbar order is Pan, Select, Pick, Place, Paint, Erase, then Undo/Redo, then Grid/Trans/Seams icons that highlight when on
Zoom sits next to 270° and goes to 32×; Resize and Kind stay compact
The zoomed tile preview only picks a color (it no longer paints)
Cell inspector: tile index beside palette, H-flip beside V-flip, Word next to Cell, View under Priority
Import Tiles appends to the tile set and leaves the map picture alone
Export greys out with a reason next to the buttons instead of an error popup; picking SNES .map.sjim or NHL 94 SNES .zip from a Genesis map converts when tiles fit (1024)
Packed is only offered when the format has both packed and unpacked; the 94S zip line lists the files inside
Export .ACT is a dialog (one palette or all combined), not a radio on the format picker
← NHL9X Studio | page title sits on one line in the Image Editor, Jerseys, and Chip lab headers
Image Editor for Genesis .map.jim, SNES .map.sjim, and NHL 94 SNES screens
Import a picture onto the map (overwrite cells, add tiles, or new image) with ACT-locked palettes
Player portrait encode; packed export matches 93G/94G DecompressBytecode
Title screens show solid ice by default; Transparency still punches VDP holes if you check it
Chip Lab is hidden from the header (the page is still there)
NHL 94 SNES pictures: face-off, team blocks, EASN, refs, fonts, sprites
93S songs by cue, named sound effects, play button
Audio and image lists aligned across 92, 93G and 93S
NHLPA 93 SNES rinks open on a team palette
Jersey editor: scoreboard crest import/export
